# The engine's `idempotency-docs-v1` route set (U-92a, engine PR #178): the
# document draft claim and convert, each `x-idempotency: true` in its
# openapi.json. A03 covers both: each is `keyable-docs` in operations.txt
# (`KeySet::DocsV1`), keyed only while the engine advertises
# `idempotency-docs-v1`. Recorded ahead of the pin (client-declared until
# the pin moves).
POST /api/v1/document-drafts
POST /api/v1/document-drafts/{id}/convert
